nodes.label: Globe Icon (globe.svg)
nodes.description: 16x16 monochrome (#666) outline globe icon with latitude/longitude meridian paths, clipped to a square clipPath. Matches the default create-next-app scaffold asset typically used for an external 'Go to nextjs.org' link.
nodes.rationale: Likely leftover from the Next.js starter template rather than a custom Shajgoj brand asset.
